findings.title: CloudWatch log group without retention
findings.description: CloudWatch log groups should set retention_in_days so logs expire on schedule. A group with no retention keeps logs forever, growing cost and breach blast radius.
findings.remediation: Enable audit logging. Turn on CloudTrail (multi-region, log file validation, KMS-encrypted bucket), VPC flow logs, and service access logs. Ship logs to a dedicated, MFA-delete-protected bucket in a security account.

findings.title: CloudWatch log group without retention period
findings.description: Hygiene: CloudWatch log groups should set retention_in_days so logs expire on a schedule instead of accumulating forever. Set retention_in_days explicitly.

evidence.expected: retention_in_days set to an explicit value
